Every host reads the same `SKILL.md` an"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"d `references/`, so behavior is consistent across vendors."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Verify install"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## The Four State Files / 四个状态文件"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| File | Holds |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `TASK_STATE.md` | Goal, scope, current phase, status, blockers. |
| `EVIDENCE_LOG.md` | Commands r"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"un, output summaries, test results, links. |
| `HANDOFF.md` | The single file to resume in <30s. |
|"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" `DECISIONS.md` | Trade-offs and why. |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Status markers enforce honesty:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Marker | Meaning |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| `[x]` | Verified — done AND proven by evidence |
